title: The 1953 Nobel citation credits Krebs with the citric acid cycle
summary: The Nobel Foundation's motivation for the 1953 medicine prize credits Hans Krebs with the discovery of the citric acid cycle.
body: The Nobel Prize API record for the 1953 prize in physiology or medicine says Hans Krebs received it for his discovery of the citric acid cycle. The date awarded in that record is 22 October 1953. The card is the prize citation. It does not list the cycle's chemical steps, which were not in the motivation sentence.

sources.title: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 1953
sources.author: Nobel Foundation
sources.note: Motivation text was read from the Nobel Prize API record.
